name: Joseph
summary: A rich man of Arimathaea and an honourable counsellor who was a disciple of Jesus, though secretly for fear of the Jews. After the crucifixion he asked Pilate for Jesus' body and laid it in his own new tomb.

key_moments.title: Begs Pilate for Jesus' Body
key_moments.description: On the evening before the sabbath, Joseph went in boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Pilate was surprised Jesus was already dead, and after the centurion confirmed it, he gave the body to Joseph.

key_moments.title: Lays Jesus in His Own New Tomb
key_moments.description: Joseph took the body and, with Nicodemus, wrapped it in linen with spices. They laid Jesus in Joseph's own new tomb cut out of the rock, in a garden near where He was crucified, and Joseph rolled a great stone to the door.
